sentences.en: The clock that got broken must be repaired right away.
sentences.zh: 那个被打坏的钟必须马上修好。

sentences.en: It took three hours to put the broken toy together.
sentences.zh: 把那件破碎的玩具拼起来花了三个小时。

sentences.en: The wrestler had his right leg broken in a bout.
sentences.zh: 摔跤手在比赛中右腿骨折了。

senses.zh: 被打碎的，骨折的，坏掉的，坏掉的
